text: 7月13日，沪深两市全天成交额合计28177.61亿元。其中，沪市成交额为13348.72亿元；深市成交额为14828.89亿元；创业板成交额为6963.41亿元。
text_en: On July 13, the total trading volume of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets was 2817.761 billion yuan. Among them, the Shanghai stock market had a trading volume of 1334.872 billion yuan, and the Shenzhen stock market had a trading volume of 1482.889 billion yuan. The ChiNext market had a trading volume of 696.341 billion yuan.
